about: Sizes (CSS pixels) for the Gear > Sheet screen. The ten equipment slot ids are unchanged; only their size and place changed. slot = side of a square equipment slot; slotMin is the smallest size a test accepts; packCell = pack grid cell (it shrinks to fit the column, never below packCellMin); stat = height of a stat row and its + button; gap = space between slots. The profile is picked from the window: desktop when wide and landscape, otherwise phoneLandscape (v73 is landscape-only on phones; portrait shows a rotate overlay). Landscape phones are only about 390px tall, so their slots are smaller than desktop.
